import sys
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext

# Set high precision for any decimal arithmetic (though all fields are scale=0 integers)
getcontext().prec = 40

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# WORKING-STORAGE (global variables mirroring COBOL fields)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
WS_INPUT = ' ' * 10          # PIC X(10)
WS_CMD = ' '                 # PIC X
WS_STATE = 'IDLE'.ljust(8)   # PIC X(8)
WS_STEPS = Decimal(0)        # PIC 9(3)
WS_REJECTS = Decimal(0)      # PIC 9(3)
WS_DONE = 'N'                # PIC X, 88 MACHINE-DONE VALUE 'Y'
WS_I = Decimal(0)            # PIC 9(2)
WS_K = Decimal(0)            # PIC 9(2)
WS_STEP_OUT = ' 0'           # PIC Z9 (edited picture)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: ACCEPT WS-INPUT (read one line, truncate/pad to 10 chars)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def accept_input():
    global WS_INPUT
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if line.endswith('\n'):
        line = line[:-1]                 # strip trailing newline only
    if len(line) > 10:
        line = line[:10]                 # truncate on the right (rule 3b)
    else:
        line = line.ljust(10)            # pad with spaces on the right
    WS_INPUT = line

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Formatting helpers for edited / numeric pictures
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def fmt_z9(val: Decimal) -> str:
    """PIC Z9: two positions, leading zero suppressed to space."""
    # Truncate high-order digits if needed (mod 100), then format
    n = int(val) % 100
    return f' {n}' if n < 10 else str(n)

def fmt_93(val: Decimal) -> str:
    """PIC 9(3): three digits, zero-padded."""
    n = int(val) % 1000
    return f'{n:03d}'

def fmt_92(val: Decimal) -> str:
    """PIC 9(2): two digits, zero-padded."""
    n = int(val) % 100
    return f'{n:02d}'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DISPLAY helpers (each writes exactly one line to stdout)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def display_step():
    # "STEP" WS-STEP-OUT " CMD [" WS-CMD "] -> " WS-STATE
    line = "STEP" + WS_STEP_OUT + " CMD [" + WS_CMD + "] -> " + WS_STATE
    sys.stdout.write(line + '\n')

def display_final():
    sys.stdout.write("FINAL   " + WS_STATE + '\n')

def display_steps():
    sys.stdout.write("STEPS   " + fmt_93(WS_STEPS) + '\n')

def display_rejects():
    sys.stdout.write("REJECTS " + fmt_93(WS_REJECTS) + '\n')

def display_exitidx():
    sys.stdout.write("EXITIDX " + fmt_92(WS_I) + '\n')

def display_afterk():
    sys.stdout.write("AFTERK  " + fmt_92(WS_K) + '\n')

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP-MACHINE paragraph (EVALUATE state machine)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def step_machine():
    global WS_STATE, WS_DONE, WS_REJECTS
    # Pre-padded state literals for exact COBOL comparison (spaces to 8 chars)
    idle     = "IDLE".ljust(8)
    running  = "RUNNING".ljust(8)
    paused   = "PAUSED".ljust(8)
    stopped  = "STOPPED".ljust(8)

    # EVALUATE WS-STATE ALSO WS-CMD (WHEN clauses in source order)
    if WS_STATE == idle and WS_CMD == 'S':
        WS_STATE = running
    elif WS_STATE == running and WS_CMD == 'P':
        WS_STATE = paused
    elif WS_STATE == paused and WS_CMD == 'S':
        WS_STATE = running
    elif WS_CMD == 'X':                     # WHEN ANY ALSO "X"
        WS_STATE = stopped
        WS_DONE = 'Y'                       # sets 88 MACHINE-DONE
    elif WS_CMD == ' ':                     # WHEN ANY ALSO SPACE
        pass                                # CONTINUE (no-op)
    else:                                   # WHEN OTHER
        WS_REJECTS += Decimal(1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN-PARA paragraph (program entry point)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def main_para():
    global WS_I, WS_K, WS_STEPS, WS_STEP_OUT, WS_CMD, WS_STATE, WS_REJECTS, WS_DONE

    accept_input()

    # PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 10 OR MACHINE-DONE
    WS_I = Decimal(1)
    while True:
        # TEST BEFORE (default) - condition checked at top of loop
        if WS_I > 10 or WS_DONE == 'Y':
            break

        # MOVE WS-INPUT(WS-I:1) TO WS-CMD  (1-indexed substring)
        WS_CMD = WS_INPUT[int(WS_I) - 1]

        step_machine()

        WS_STEPS += Decimal(1)
        WS_STEP_OUT = fmt_z9(WS_STEPS)      # MOVE WS-STEPS TO WS-STEP-OUT
        display_step()

        WS_I += Decimal(1)                  # VARYING increment

    # MOVE ZERO TO WS-K
    WS_K = Decimal(0)

    # PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL WS-K >= 0
    while True:
        WS_K += Decimal(1)                  # body executes at least once
        if WS_K >= 0:                       # TEST AFTER condition
            break

    # Summary displays
    display_final()
    display_steps()
    display_rejects()
    display_exitidx()
    display_afterk()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Program entry
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    main_para()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

      *> Gotcha 1: PERFORM ... WITH TEST AFTER runs the body ONCE even when
      *>           the UNTIL condition is already true on entry. TEST BEFORE
      *>           (the default) does not.
      *> Gotcha 2: the VARYING loop exits on a compound OR, so the control

      *>           ended it - and that value is displayed.
      *> Gotcha 3: a level-88 inside the UNTIL is re-evaluated every pass.
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. STATEMACH.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-INPUT            PIC X(10)    VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-CMD              PIC X        VALUE SPACE.
       01  WS-STATE            PIC X(8)     VALUE "IDLE".
       01  WS-STEPS            PIC 9(3)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-REJECTS          PIC 9(3)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-DONE             PIC X        VALUE "N".
           88  MACHINE-DONE                 VALUE "Y".
       01  WS-I                PIC 9(2)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-K                PIC 9(2)     VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-STEP-OUT         PIC Z9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           ACCEPT WS-INPUT
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
                   UNTIL WS-I > 10 OR MACHINE-DONE
               MOVE WS-INPUT(WS-I:1) TO WS-CMD
               PERFORM STEP-MACHINE
               ADD 1 TO WS-STEPS
               MOVE WS-STEPS TO WS-STEP-OUT
               DISPLAY "STEP" WS-STEP-OUT " CMD [" WS-CMD "] -> "
                   WS-STATE
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE ZERO TO WS-K
           PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL WS-K >= 0
               ADD 1 TO WS-K
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY "FINAL   " WS-STATE
           DISPLAY "STEPS   " WS-STEPS
           DISPLAY "REJECTS " WS-REJECTS
           DISPLAY "EXITIDX " WS-I
           DISPLAY "AFTERK  " WS-K
           STOP RUN.
       STEP-MACHINE.
           EVALUATE WS-STATE ALSO WS-CMD
               WHEN "IDLE"    ALSO "S"
                   MOVE "RUNNING" TO WS-STATE
               WHEN "RUNNING" ALSO "P"
                   MOVE "PAUSED" TO WS-STATE
               WHEN "PAUSED"  ALSO "S"
                   MOVE "RUNNING" TO WS-STATE
               WHEN ANY       ALSO "X"
                   MOVE "STOPPED" TO WS-STATE
                   MOVE "Y" TO WS-DONE
               WHEN ANY       ALSO SPACE
                   CONTINUE
               WHEN OTHER
                   ADD 1 TO WS-REJECTS
           END-EVALUATE.
